repair_path: to retire an entry: publish a successor theorem note that restates the result with all four ledgers and re-pin the dependent package to it, or have the dependent package re-pin the edited bytes; the entry then drops automatically
rule: Each entry is a named result that lacks one or more AA theorem ledgers in a theorem note whose CURRENT bytes are sha256-pinned by a record of a DIFFERENT package, so the ledgers cannot be added in place without breaking that package's custody check. The gate re-verifies every entry on every run (live sha256 == pin_sha256; the record exists outside the pinned package and carries the sha256; the result is live, identified and non-compliant) and drops any entry that fails, which re-enforces it. The frozen LEDGER_BASELINE_V1.json is unchanged; the repo-wide debt allowance grows by exactly the number of verified entries.
